title: Librarian Manifest
description: Librarian runtime state: inventory, cross-reference graph, tag inventory, scan state, drift findings, architect recommendations, rename history. Runtime writes owned by the librarian capabilities. drift_findings declares NO required children: it is a per-scope sub-leaf namespace whose keys are owned by the capabilities that declare writes_manifest_subtree — see drift_findings.description.

by_type.description: Map: canonical file type -> inventory records or counts

xref_graph.description: Cross-reference graph (wikilinks, canonical-file links, explicit references). Inner shape owned by runtime writer.

tags.description: Tag inventory (tag -> occurrences). Inner shape owned by runtime writer.

last_scanned_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent full-scan cycle

findings_by_capability.description: Map: capability id -> scan findings record

drift_findings.description: Per-SCOPE drift-finding sub-leaves. Every librarian capability that declares a writes_manifest_subtree owns exactly ONE leaf here, keyed by its own scope: drift_findings.frontmatter (frontmatter-enforce), .placement (placement-validate, itself scope-keyed as .placement.vault / .placement.plans_root), .stale (stale-detect), and the same one-leaf-per-owner shape for tag_coverage, index_maintain, coverage_guard, rename_detected and any later scope. The discipline is structural, not stylistic: manifest_set REPLACES its target leaf wholesale, so a capability that persisted this PARENT object would obliterate every sibling scope's leaf on every run. NO scope key is required and none is enumerated here — a manifest that has never run a given capability simply carries no leaf for it, and additionalProperties:true admits every scope key without the schema tracking the capability roster. A leaf's INNER shape is owned by its writer and lists are legal at any depth: frontmatter carries provides_canonicality / size_monitoring / schema_type_coverage as finding LISTS alongside schema_version + last_scan; placement and stale carry summary objects; rename_detected is a flat list. A long-lived manifest may also carry parent-level residue from before the sub-leaf discipline; it is admitted rather than migrated.

last_scanned_log.description: Path to the most recent architect log file consumed

id.description: Architect recommendation ID. The AR-NNN pattern is chosen so these ids cannot collide with the R-NNN governance rule-id space.

status.description: Lifecycle status. Tracked = under active monitoring; completed = recommendation acted on; deferred = revisit next cadence; rejected = decided against; open = newly emitted, awaiting triage.

source_report.description: Path to the architect-{date}.md report that emitted this recommendation.

first_seen.description: ISO-8601 date the recommendation was first emitted.

last_seen.description: ISO-8601 date the recommendation was most recently re-emitted (for convergence tracking).
